ARGOS — Academic Research Governance, Opposition & Synthesis — v1.8

FUNCTIONAL MEANING
ARGOS expands to Academic Research Governance, Opposition & Synthesis.

CONCEPTUAL MEANING
Argos evokes the watchful guardian of Greek mythology: observant, difficult to deceive, and able to keep many things under scrutiny at once. The name fits a research framework that watches evidence from multiple expert perspectives, verifies sources, challenges assumptions, searches for contradictions, and keeps the full research problem in view before synthesizing conclusions.

PROJECT PURPOSE
ARGOS is the CASPER-derived academic, scientific, technical, R&D, policy, standards, and official-research framework. It accepts a question and/or source material, assembles an appropriate 10–15-expert panel, researches and validates evidence, opposes premature conclusions through adversarial review, and produces streamlined professional publications.

============================================================
README
============================================================

WHAT ARGOS DOES

ARGOS conducts deep academic and scientific research rather than simple source summarization. It can work from a subject, question, files, datasets, papers, URLs, prior research, or combinations of these materials.

MAJOR CAPABILITIES

• Dynamic 10–15-expert research panel.
• Deep literature and evidence acquisition.
• Source verification and evidence grading.
• Quantitative, methodological, causal, and systems analysis.
• Competing-hypothesis analysis and falsification.
• Red-team and reproducibility review.
• Research-gap identification.
• Study and experiment design.
• R&D and technical feasibility analysis.
• Final scientific peer-review gate.
• Professional publication selection and production.
• Autonomous continuation until completion or a material blocker.

RELATED FRAMEWORKS

CASPER is the parent analytical framework. ARGOS is its specialized academic/scientific research and publication fork. FORGE, IRIS, READ, AOS, and WEAVER remain independent external frameworks and are not duplicated here.

DEPENDENCIES

No software dependency is required for the prompt framework. Live research requires suitable search/retrieval capability and access to any necessary source materials. ARGOS must never invent inaccessible evidence.

QUICK START

1. Open ARGOS_v1.8_MASTER.txt.
2. Make it the governing ARGOS instruction set.
3. Provide a research subject/question and relevant files or sources.
4. Invoke @ARGOS AUTO or a specific mode.
5. ARGOS defines or recommends the research route and publication type.
6. ARGOS continues autonomously until the deliverable is complete or material user input is required.

See ARGOS_v1.8_QUICKSTART.txt for commands and ARGOS_v1.8_INSTRUCTIONS.txt for full usage.


DESIGN MANTRA
ARGOS v1.8 applies modules/ARGOS_v1.8_DESIGN_MANTRA.txt as a persistent governing doctrine: whole-product research, one authoritative state, lean execution, explainability, measured validation, preservation of validated work, and remove-before-add discipline.

UIbasic INTEGRATION

ARGOS v1.8 integrates UIbasic v1.0 as its persistent status/control presentation protocol. UI AUTO is the default. Use @ARGOS UI TINY, @ARGOS UI COMPACT, @ARGOS UI FULL, or @ARGOS UI AUTO to select presentation detail. UIbasic displays authoritative ARGOS state and does not create duplicate research/progress state.


PERSISTENT IDENTITY
♉ ARGOS is displayed whenever ARGOS is invoked or active.

ACTIVE SYMBOL
♉ ARGOS = persistent ARGOS identity.
♉🐕‍🦺 ARGOS = ARGOS has been called or is actively operating.
